title: Rav Acha son of Rav Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 101a, raising an objection to Rav Ashi; but Hyman says the reading should be “son of Rava,” as in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The actual William Davidson Shabbat 101a paragraph has Rav Acha son of Rav Acha addressing Rav Ashi. Hyman’s proposed “son of Rava” reading remains his report of Dikdukei Soferim; that apparatus was not freshly collated here. The heading is retained separately from the proposed patronymic, without an identity binding.
